description_en: Exports a list of data sources
name: ExportDataSources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the data sources belong. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html operation to query the ID of the workspace
parameters.help_zh: 目标数据源所在的DataWorks工作空间ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html接口获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword contained in the names of the data sources that you want to export. You can specify only one keyword. For example, if you set this parameter to test, you can call the ExportDataSources operation to export all data sources whose names contain test in the workspace
parameters.help_zh:
待导出的目标数据源名称所包含的关键字。
当前仅支持配置一个关键字。例如，该参数配置为test（即待导出的目标数据源名称所包含的关键字为test），则调用ExportDataSources接口会导出目标工作空间中所有名称包含test的数据源
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

odps
mysql
rds
oss
sqlserver
polardb
oracle
mongodb
emr
postgresql
analyticdb_for_mysql
hybriddb_for_postgresql
holo

目标数据源的类型。常用的类型如下：
odps
mysql
rds
oss
sqlserver

oracle
mongodb
emr

parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.help_en:
The subtype of the data source. This parameter takes effect only when the DataSourceType parameter is set to rds.

If the value of the DataSourceType parameter is rds, the value of this parameter can be mysql, sqlserver, or postgresql
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据源的子类型。仅当DataSourceType参数配置为RDS时，该参数生效。

当DataSourceType参数配置为RDS时，该参数可以配置为mysql、sqlserver或postgresql
parameters.name: sub_type

parameters.help_en:
The environment in which the data source resides. Valid values:

0: development environment
1: production environment
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据源所属的环境。取值如下：
0：开发环境。
1：生产环境
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大为100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的页码。取值为大于等于1的正整数
parameters.name: page_number

Data.description_en: The information about the exported data sources
Data.description_zh: 批量导出数据源的返回结果

DataSources.description_en: The details of the exported data sources. The value is an array. The following parameters are the elements in the array. The sample values of these parameters show the details of a sample data source
DataSources.description_zh:
批量导出的数据源的详细信息。
此次调用的返回结果为导出数据源的详细信息数组，如下信息为数组中的一个数据源的详细信息示例

BindingCalcEngineId.description_en: The ID of the compute engine that is added as the data source

ConnectStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the data source is connected to an exclusive resource group. Valid values:

1: The data source is connected to at least one exclusive resource group.
0: The data source is not connected to any exclusive resource group
ConnectStatus.description_zh:
数据源与任意独享资源组的连通性状态。取值如下：
1：表示数据源至少与一个独享资源组连通。
0：表示数据源与所有独享资源组均未连通

DefaultEngine.description_en:
Indicates whether the compute engine that is added as the data source is the default compute engine. Valid values:

true: The compute engine is the default compute engine.
false: The compute engine is not the default compute engine
DefaultEngine.description_zh:
数据源所在的引擎是否为默认引擎。取值如下：
true：是默认引擎。
false：不是默认引擎

Description.description_en: The description of the data source

EnvType.description_en:
The environment in which the data source resides. Valid values:

0: development environment
1: production environment
EnvType.description_zh:
数据源所属的环境。取值如下：
0：开发环境。
1：生产环境

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the data source was created. Example: Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM
GmtCreate.description_zh: 数据源的创建时间。格式示例为：Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the data source was last modified. Example: Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM
GmtModified.description_zh: 最近一次修改数据源的时间。格式示例为：Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM

Name.description_en: The name of the data source

Operator.description_en: The ID of the user who exported the data source

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the data source belongs
ProjectId.description_zh: 数据源所属的DataWorks工作空间ID

Sequence.description_en: The sequence number of the data source

Shared.description_en:
Indicates whether the data source can be shared. Valid values:

true: The data source can be shared.
false: The data source cannot be shared
Shared.description_zh:
数据源是否可以分享。取值如下：
true：数据源可以分享。
false：数据源不可以分享

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the data source is available. Valid values:

1: The data source is available.
0: The data source is unavailable
Status.description_zh:
数据源是否可用。取值如下：
1：表示数据源可用。
0：表示数据源不可用

SubType.description_en:
The subtype of the data source. This parameter takes effect only when the DataSourceType parameter is set to rds.

If the value of the DataSourceType parameter is rds, the value of this parameter can be mysql, sqlserver, or postgresql
SubType.description_zh:
数据源的子类型。仅当DataSourceType参数配置为RDS时，该参数生效。

当DataSourceType参数配置为RDS时，该参数可以取值为mysql、sqlserver或postgresql

TenantId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the data source belongs
TenantId.description_zh: 数据源所属租户的租户ID

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页查询的页码。取值为大于等于1的正整数

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 返回满足条件的数据源总条数

HttpStatusCode.description_en:
The HTTP status code returned. Valid values:

200: The request was successful.
Other values: The request failed. You can troubleshoot issues based on the HTTP status code returned
HttpStatusCode.description_zh:
此次调用的返回结果状态。取值如下：
200：表示此次调用的返回结果成功。
其他值：表示此次调用的返回结果异常。您可以根据对应错误码处理相关异常

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can locate logs and troubleshoot issues based on the ID
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。
false：失败
